source.description: same-revision public near-front studio image persisted by OLEANDER reference-image acquisition

measurement.method: Hough-circle candidates cross-checked against the two visible round headlamp lenses; main body width estimated from the continuous dark vehicle body span near the lamp/bumper zone, excluding mirrors
measurement.uncertainty_note: studio perspective, lens bezel thickness and threshold selection remain; ratios are screening/causal design targets, not engineering dimensions

identity_relations: round lamp lens is integrated inside the raised fender crown rather than attached to a flat front wall
hood center mass reads lower/less dominant than the twin outer fender crowns around the lamps
lower intake mass begins below the lamp/fender band and must not replace the primary hood/fender relationship
allowed_transfer: lamp/fender gross position, lamp visible diameter proportion, hood-valley vs fender-crown identity relation
forbidden_transfer: engineering lamp package dimensions, exact optical module, fascia tooling, homologation lighting geometry, manufacturer surface CAD
